# Context Map (generated by tools/gen_context_map.py - do not edit)

## app
app: thin shell - Application, navigation host, wiring of feature modules.
- `src/main/kotlin/com/angel/remoteassist/MainActivity.kt`: Placeholder launcher activity; replaced by nav host at M-02/M-01.

## core/core-api
core-api: Interfaces between features and data (InviteService, SessionTransport). No implementations.
- `src/main/kotlin/com/angel/remoteassist/api/Interfaces.kt`: Contracts features use instead of depending on each other: InviteService, SessionTransport.

## core/core-model
core-model: Shared types: Role, Capability, HelpMode, Angel, Grant, Session. No Android types.
- `src/main/kotlin/com/angel/remoteassist/model/Capability.kt`: Enum of things an Angel may be allowed to do. MVP = view/guide/voice only; Act capabilities arrive in Phase 2.
- `src/main/kotlin/com/angel/remoteassist/model/HelpMode.kt`: Help modes: WATCH (view), GUIDE (draw + shortcuts), ACT (remote control, Phase 2, off by default).
- `src/main/kotlin/com/angel/remoteassist/model/Models.kt`: Core data types: Role, Angel, Grant, SessionState. Plain Kotlin, no Android types.

## core/core-permissions
core-permissions: Capability and consent rules engine: grants, durations, cool-off, revoke. Pure Kotlin.

## core/core-ui
core-ui: Design system: theme, large-text mode, shared Compose components (Stop button, status chip).

## core/core-util
core-util: Safe logging (no sensitive data), time and result helpers. Pure Kotlin.

## data/data-push
data-push: FCM wake-up handling (no persistent connections).

## data/data-signalling
data-signalling: Network signalling client implementing core-api interfaces. Provider chosen after F-06.

## data/data-storage
data-storage: Local encrypted storage for pairings, grants, logs.

## feature/feature-activitylog
feature-activitylog: Local audit log and viewer.

## feature/feature-comms
feature-comms: Voice and text chat during a session.

## feature/feature-consent
feature-consent: Per-session consent prompt and result handling.

## feature/feature-guidance
feature-guidance: Overlay drawing (arrows, highlights, text) on User screen.

## feature/feature-onboarding
feature-onboarding: First-run onboarding and role selection.

## feature/feature-pairing
feature-pairing: Invites, pairing, Angel management, block/report.

## feature/feature-screenshare
feature-screenshare: Screen capture (User), viewer (Angel), sensitive-screen masking.

## feature/feature-session
feature-session: Session lifecycle, foreground service, indicator, stop/revoke, reconnect.

## feature/feature-shortcuts
feature-shortcuts: Deep links/intents: settings, message draft, contacts, maps, calendar.
